content.json:
# Cost & Ingestion
Where the Log Analytics bill comes from. Review monthly: the top table should be a deliberate choice, not a surprise.

content.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize IngestedGB = sum(Quantity) / 1000 by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: Daily billable ingestion (GB, 30 d)

content.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize IngestedGB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1000, 2) by DataType
| order by IngestedGB desc
content.title: Billable ingestion by table (30 d)

content.query:
find where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) project _BilledSize, Computer
| where isnotempty(Computer)
| summarize BilledGB = round(sum(_BilledSize) / 1e9, 2) by Computer
| order by BilledGB desc
| take 20
content.title: Top 20 computers by billed volume (7 d)
